description: Draws a device (bezel, status bar and browser bars) around a PNG screenshot taken elsewhere, such as by Playwright MCP. Take the screenshot at the size view_sim_device_viewport gives for that device; a different shape is fitted to the device's width and cut or padded at the bottom. The result has a transparent background. Needs no extension.

background.description: Fills the page area below a screenshot that is too short

browser.description: Browser UI and user agent to emulate. Defaults to Safari on Apple devices, Chrome on Android.

image_path.description: Path to the PNG screenshot of the page (the viewport only, not the whole window)

mode.description: device: with bezel and stand; screen: display with status and browser bars

save_dir.description: Also write the PNGs to this directory and return their paths

theme_color.description: The page's theme-color, which tints Safari's bars on phones

title.description: Shown on the tab, on desktop browsers

name: view_sim_frame
title: Frame a screenshot
